entities.summary: Alexander Bengt Magnus Bard is a Swedish musician, author, lecturer, artist, songwriter, music producer, TV personality, religious and political activist, and one of the founders of the Syntheist religious movement alongside his co-author Jan Söderqvist. Bard is a member of music band Army of Lovers. Alexander Bard was a performers & entertainers from Motala Municipality (b. 1961-03-17, Motala Municipality). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
